analysis_groups.shared_proof_pattern: Split a circular DLL segment at an arbitrary prefix/anchor boundary and fold the same shape after inserting one explicit node.
analysis_groups.shared_space_plan: One split helper opens the pre-list around the anchor; one join helper folds prefix, anchor, inserted node, and the suffix before xizi_dll_close.
analysis_groups.shared_pure_plan: Use list destruct/rewrite, dllseg cons/empty equalities, explicit non-null premises, and link-field separation for stop inequalities.
analysis_groups.grouping_reason: All three witnesses concern one function, one mathematical sequence transformation, and one mutually useful dllseg split/join helper family; three witnesses are below the controller limit of 12.

proof_groups.proof_strategy: Prove group-suffixed arbitrary-prefix dllseg split and insertion-join helpers in the group-local case_lib. Use split + suffix case analysis for entail_wit_1. For return_wit_1 and return_wit_2 choose the left disjunct, rewrite xizi_double_link_insert_after_nodes, fold the nonempty or empty tail, join the segment, and apply xizi_dll_close.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: The three obligations share the same DLL predicate, the same list insertion equation, and the same split/join helper family; keeping them together lets one worker prove and reuse the suffixed helpers, and the group size 3 is within the limit 12.
